topic: Monitor alerts to an email address never arrive from one org
symptom_pattern: Alerts to an email-to-ticket address are delivered from one org but not another; other recipients on the same monitor get alerts. No error on the monitor.
root_cause: In the failing org, the address matches a pending user invitation (or disabled user), so it's treated as a user handle and silently excluded from delivery.
resolution_path: Check Organization Settings > Users for a pending invite or disabled user with that address
Delete the pending invite and re-test notifications

qa_pairs.tse_question: Is that email address listed under users in the failing org?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Hmm, it shows as Pending; someone invited it by mistake last year.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Do other handles on the same monitor receive alerts?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Yes, Slack and two people get them.
